attorneys.name: Stephen A. Williams
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Law Lawyers in Dalton, GA
attorneys.bio:
Steve "Scoop" Williams is known around the area as one of the premier criminal defense lawyers in the State of Georgia. As the former elected District Attorney, Steve has tried nearly 400 civil and criminal jury trials to verdict in both State and Federal Courts, and enjoys a reputation for thoroughness in his preparation and aggressiveness in his presentation of cases to juries. He is an AV Preeminent-rated attorney who has practiced law since 1976, and represents people who have suffered catastrophic personal injuries, families who have lost loved ones through wrongful death, and those people who have been targeted for criminal prosecution.

In the area of personal injury, Steve has handled many car wreck cases as well as a number of premises liability issues, many of which have resulted in settlements of more than $100,000.00 and wrongful death cases in excess of $1,000,000.00.

Steve has been lead defense counsel in criminal cases as small as traffic tickets and as large as capital murder, after leaving the DA's office on January 1, 1985.

A graduate of the University of Georgia (B.B.A. in 1973 and J.D. in 1976), Steve has been a lawyer in Dalton, Georgia, since 1977. First, as an Assistant DA, he was then appointed District Attorney by the Governor to fill a vacancy created when Charles A. Pannell Jr. became a Superior Court Judge. Following Steve's appointment, he ran for and served a full term as DA. He then left office and began practicing law with McCamy, Phillips, Tuggle & Fordham, LLP, where he presently serves as Managing Partner.

Steve has been very active in community, civic, and church affairs, and has served on a number of boards and committees, as well as having been elected to the Dalton Board of Education, where he served as Chairman for eight years. Steve's term on the Board of Education ends December 31, 2013. Steve also serves as City Attorney for the City of Chatsworth, Georgia.

attorneys.name: John Parker Wills
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Thomson, GA
attorneys.bio:
John is a graduate of the University of Georgia and Cumberland School of Law, Samford University, Birmingham, Alabama. Mr. Wills is a member of the State Bar of Georgia and the Toombs Circuit Bar Association. He prides himself as being there when his clients need him and takes the time to understand their legal problems and how those problems affect their lives and their families. John looks at the whole picture and finds solutions that work best for each individual.

Mr. Wills’ primary practice is focused around helping clients with debt relief by filing for bankruptcy relief under the Bankruptcy Code. With over 30 years experience, he is highly qualified to meet the many challenges that his clients bring him, including foreclosure protection. His general law practice also encompasses the practice of real estate, wills and estates and family law.

John Wills was born and raised in Washington, Georgia and received a Bachelor of Business Administration at the University of Georgia before attending Cumberland School of Law. He began his legal career practicing law in Thomson, Georgia, and in 1994 opened his own law firm, Fowler & Wills, L.L.C., in Thomson with his law partner, Samuel A. Fowler, Jr.

Besides his practice of law, Mr. Wills enjoys sports, spending time with his family and being active in the Community.

attorneys.name: Morris Wiltshire
attorneys.practice_type: DUI Defense Lawyers in Watkinsville, GA
attorneys.bio:
MORRIS H. WILTSHIRE, JR. “Mo” is a Partner with Prior, Daniel & Wiltshire, LLC.

Former prosecutor Mo Wiltshire is widely recognized as one of the top trial lawyers in Georgia. Mo is one of the very few lawyers in Georgia to have earned the rating “Superb” scoring a perfect “10.0/10.0″ by AVVO.com, the world’s largest online legal directory and attorney rating and review organization, in both Criminal Defense and DUI Defense. In the State of Georgia less than 5% of lawyers have earned these top ratings in both Criminal Defense and DUI Defense. As a former felony prosecutor and a former DUI prosecutor Mo Wiltshire possesses a breadth and depth of experience that is very difficult to find elsewhere.

Mo Wiltshire has been formally recognized by numerous national organizations for outstanding achievement and overall excellence as a trial attorney and advocate for his clients.

Mo Wiltshire is rated as possessing “Very High Ethical Standards” by Martindale-Hubbell the peer review attorney ethics rating guide. Mo holds a ranking as a “Top 10 Defense Attorney” in the State of Georgia by The National Academy of Criminal Defense Attorneys. Mo was also selected as one of the “Top 100 Criminal Defense Lawyers” in the State of Georgia by The American Society of Legal Advocates and as a “Top 100 Trial Lawyer” in the area of Criminal Defense by the National Trial Lawyers: Top 100 Lawyers group. Mo has also been recognized as one of the top DUI Defense Attorneys in the state by the National Advocacy for DUI Defense.

Mo graduated cum laude from Millsaps College in Jackson, MS in 1991 and received his J.D. degree from the University of Georgia School of Law in 1994. His law school honors include being named to the Order of Barristers. Mo was admitted to the Georgia Bar in 1994 and began his legal career serving as an Assistant District Attorney in Cherokee and Forsyth counties in the North Metro Atlanta area. After several years as a prosecutor, he returned to Athens and began the private practice of law focusing on civil and criminal cases requiring litigation. After roughly a decade of successful law practice, Mo Wiltshire was selected as the Republican Party Nominee for District Attorney for Athens-Clarke and Oconee County in 2004. Mo was endorsed by the Police Benevolent Association of Georgia, Inc., the Athens-Banner Herald, and the Athens Daily News during the election. Mo was appointed by the Governor as Solicitor-General for Athens-Clarke County and served in that post until 2007.

Solicitor-General for Athens (Former DUI Prosecutor)

Assistant District Attorney (Former Felony Prosecutor)

Special Prosecutor in Death Investigations for the Athens-Clarke County Coroner’s Office

Instructor, Athens-Clarke County Police Department

Instructor, Georgia’s G. Christy Memorial Trial Skills Clinic

As Solicitor-General he was commissioned with leading the office charged with the prosecution of DUI offenses in Athens. When his term as Solicitor-General expired he joined the law firm that became Prior, Daniel & Wiltshire and resumed the private practice of law.

Mo Wiltshire maintains a heavy focus on jury trials in this law practice including regular and extensive criminal jury trial work in courts throughout Georgia and the Southeast as well as business, insurance, and serious personal injury litigation. Mo takes to heart the guiding principle of his practice “helping good people in big trouble all over Georgia.” He is a frequent presenter for continuing legal education programs, for regional civic and fraternal organizations. Mo provides expert commentary and analysis for local and regional news media and has been featured in the Athens Banner-Herald, the Atlanta Journal-Constitution, Flagpole Magazine, Scout.com, WGAU, WSB and others.

He is a member of the Georgia Bar Association, The Georgia Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers and the Western Circuit Bar Association (Treasurer 2005-2006). Mo Wiltshire has served and continues to serve in many capacities in the community including as the Special Prosecutor for Athens-Clarke County Coroner’s Inquests in Death Investigations. He serves as a Volunteer Instructor for the Athens-Clarke County Police Department in the departments New Officer Investigation Courses (2000-present). He also serves as a Faculty Member for the Institute of Continuing Legal Education in the Georgia Trial Skills Clinic (1999-present). Mo is a frequent speaker for civic groups and social organizations regarding Underage Alcohol Consumption, DUI and Liability Issues, he has served with the American Cancer Society Relay for Life, as a Judge for many Mock Trial and Moot Court competitions sponsored by the Georgia Bar Association, and as the lawyer’s chair of the United Way of Northeast Georgia, Doctors v. Lawyers Basketball Challenge.

Mo is married to the former Hope Vance of Athens and has two daughters, Mia and Lila. He and his family reside in Athens.

attorneys.name: Drew Winslett
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Johns Creek, GA
attorneys.bio:
Drew Winslett is an associate attorney with Meriwether & Tharp, LLC. A Georgia native, he graduated from Mercer University in 2017 with a bachelors degree in Political Science and Law, Public Policy & Ethics, with a minor in Economics. Drew was inducted into the inaugural class of Phi Beta Kappa and was recognized with a "Mercer Bear" award for outstanding contributions to the university during his four years. Following graduation, Drew moved to Winston Salem, NC where he attended law school at Wake Forest University.

During law school, Drew worked in the Elder Law Clinic, helping seniors navigate important decisions regarding Medicare coverage, estate planning, and end-of-life planning. He embodied Wake Forest's "Pro Humanitate" spirit of using ones' talents to improve the lives of others, as he was inducted into the Pro Bono Honors Society, volunteering for various projects such as Teen Court and the Expungement Clinic.

Drew returned home to Georgia after law school and began practicing family law with a small private practice. It was here that he gained valuable experience in various family matters, including divorce, child custody, child support, and equitable division of the marital estate, among others.

Outside of the office, Drew enjoys spending time with his wife, Lindsey, and their black lab, Pippa. He enjoys reading, watching sports (especially the Boston Red Sox), and hiking. As an avid hiker, he aspires to travel to all 63 national parks, having already been to about half of them.

attorneys.name: Jack F. Witcher (1942
attorneys.firm_name: The Law Office of Jack F. Witcher
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Bremen, GA
attorneys.bio:
Jack Witcher graduated from Bremen High School, and was the Valedictorian of his graduating class. He graduated from Georgia Institute of Technology with a Bachelor of Science Degree in Industrial Management, and obtained his Law Degree from the University of Georgia. Mr. Witcher was a member of Phi Alpha Delta, and then was admitted to practice law in Georgia.

Mr. Witcher is admitted to practice before the U.S. Supreme Court and U.S. Tax Court, all Georgia appellate courts, and the U.S. District Court for the Northern and Middle Districts of Georgia. Mr. Witcher is a past president of the Tallapoosa Judicial Circuit Bar Association, and is currently a member of the Atlanta Bar Association.

Prior to opening his own firm, Mr. Witcher practiced law for 18 years with the late Thomas B. Murphy, former Speaker of the House of Representatives of the State of Georgia, and was a partner in the law firm of Murphy, Witcher, Murphy in Bremen, Georgia.

During his years of practice, Mr. Witcher has handled almost every type of litigation in both State and Federal Courts. Presently, Mr. Witcher's practice is primarily limited to the areas of Workers' Compensation, Personal Injury Litigation, and litigated Estate matters, although he does handle other cases involving real property disputes, domestic relations, criminal defense and other general legal matters. During his practice, Mr. Witcher has served as Attorney for the City of Bremen, Haralson County, and the Haralson County Water Authority. At present, Mr. Witcher represents the Bremen City Schools Board of Education.

Mr. Witcher has attained Martindale Hubbell's s highest rating for ethical standards and legal ability for over three decades.

attorneys.name: Susan Witt
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Atlanta, GA
attorneys.bio:
Susan Witt graduated from South Texas College of Law in Houston, Texas in 1998.

She worked for a small boutique medical malpractice defense firm in Houston where she defended hospitals, nursing homes and a variety of other medical providers throughout Texas until 2003.

Susan relocated with her family in 2003 to Atlanta to work for a well respected insurance defense firm where she gained valuable experience working on a variety of legal matters defending claims. Susan has focused her career on civil litigation and in 2009, after gathering valuable experience as an insurance defense lawyer for over ten years, Susan moved to the Plaintiff's bar where she is fully committed to the representation of her injured clients.

Susan has a broad level of experience in pursuing a variety of personal injury matters including, but not limited to, auto accidents, premises liability and products liability. She has vast experience with medical malpractice, nursing malpractice, nursing home, assisted living and elder care abuse matters.

She takes on a select number of cases as Susan is not a high volume based lawyer. Rather she is committed to taking on quality cases with clear injuries and damages. Susan is committed to giving each of her cases personalized attention and ensuring effective communication with each client and their family. She has established strong and ongoing relationships with many of her clients who refer her to friends and family members because they know she will offer a high level of legal service with personalized attention.

Outside of practicing law Susan enjoys being a mother to three children and is active in their school, church and various community organizations.

attorneys.name: W. Orson Woodall
attorneys.practice_type: Ch 7, Ch 13, Ch 12, Ch 11- Debtor Bankruptcy Lawyers in Valdosta, GA
attorneys.bio:
Orson Woodall, owner and founder of Woodall and Woodall, is a 25-year veteran attorney helping Georgians break free of the stress and difficulty of overwhelming debt through bankruptcy. He entered the field of law only after an early career following in his family's business of small market broadcasting. When he experienced the personal crisis of losing nearly everything-home, vehicles and his pride-- through some poor deals, he elected to return to school. Law school. Today, from those humbling experiences, he has grown his practice of personal and business bankruptcy. He learned the hard lesson personally that financial hardships can cripple any individual and family through any series of varying factors. Fueled by the strength of overcoming his own crisis, he grew committed to assisting individuals and small businesses to maintain dignity and escape the clawing, shaming, and often predatory practices of harassing creditors. His toolbox is chock full of tools and options such as debt restructuring, credit rebuilding and, of course, bankruptcy. Based in Valdosta, GA, Orson Woodall and his Woodall and Woodall firm have assisted more than 20,000 individuals strengthen their financial situations and regain dignity and pride. Woodall and Woodall boast a staff with more than 20 years of bankruptcy experience. Dedicated to personalized, expert attention, Orson Woodall and his team approaches each individual situation with specialized attention and advises the best solution based on its circumstances. In short, Orson Woodall and Woodall and Woodall helps neighbors from the weight of crushing financial hardships. Let them help you through YOUR debt challenges.

Awards and Honors

Honors

The Pro Bono Project of The State Bar of Georgia, 1995 - Present

Champion of The Order of Protectors of Consumer Debtors-NACBA, 1999 - Present

attorneys.name: Edward M. Wynn
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Atlanta, GA
attorneys.bio:
Edward M. Wynn is an attorney with Slappey & Sadd, LLC. His practice focuses exclusively on catastrophic personal injury and wrongful death cases. He has successfully represented hundreds of personal injury victims in cases involving trucking and automobile wrecks, premises liability claims, medical malpractice, and intentional torts. Edward has also successfully handled numerous appeals before both the Georgia Court of Appeals and the Supreme Court of Georgia.

After graduating from the Mercer University Walter F. George School of Law in 2007, Edward was admitted to the State Bar of Georgia that same year. During law school, he received the Frank C. Jones Scholarship, a CALI Excellence for the Future Award in Evidence, and a Certificate in Advanced Legal Writing and Research from Mercer Law's top-ranked legal writing program. Prior to law school, Edward graduated magna cum laude from the University of Georgia with a BA in Political Science from UGA's School of Public and International Affairs.

Edward strongly believes that attorneys are called to serve others and the community at large. Edward co-founded Step Up, Atlanta!, a non-profit organization that has organized fundraisers and volunteers service opportunities benefiting charities such as the US Marine Corps Toys for Tots Foundation, the Special Olympics of Georgia, and the Atlanta Community Food Bank. He has also served as Chairman of the Board of Governors of the Beta Xi Chapter (UGA) of the Phi Kappa Tau Fraternity. Edward is currently a member of the Board of Directors of the Crime Victims Advocacy Council, an organization dedicated to assisting crime victims and their families through education, counseling, and legislative initiatives.

Outside the practice of law, Edward's interests include travel, US history, technology/computers, and UGA football. He grew up in Atlanta and resides here with his wife and their daughters.

attorneys.name: Jeffrey Yazinski
attorneys.practice_type: Social Security Disability Lawyers in Macon, GA
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Yazinski was born at Fort Knox, Kentucky and as a military dependant has traveled extensively. He has lived in a variety of places both within the continental United States, and abroad. He is a graduate of Zama American High School, Camp Zama, Japan. Mr. Yazinski was also a member of the armed forces, having served in the United State Army, Infantry (Airborne). Duty stations include Leighton Barracks, Germany, where he served as Communications Advisor for the 3rd Infantry Division's Long Range Surveillance unit.

While a law student Mr. Yazinski clerked at Sullivan and Kight, and worked in the areas of general civil litigation, and criminal defense. He also served a clerkship with the Houston County District Attorney's office in his last year of law school. Upon graduation from law school he began his practice with Westmoreland, Patterson, Moseley & Hinson. Mr. Yazinski has lectured both attorneys and employers on issues of employment law. He represents social security claimants throughout the southeast, at the administrative and the appellate levels. He also frequently provides his appellate expertise to non-attorney disability practitioners. When away from the office Mr. Yazinski's interests include: Irish Wolfhounds, and motorcycling. He is member of the BMW Motorcycle Owners of America.

attorneys.name: J. Christopher York
attorneys.practice_type: Workers Compensation Lawyers in Forest Park, GA
attorneys.bio:
CHRIS YORK received his undergraduate degree in Economics from California State University at Dominguez Hills, and an MBA in Accounting from the University of California, Berkeley, Graduate School of Business. Before entering graduate school, he joined the Peace Corps and served two years in West Malaysia as an agricultural project analyst. Chris worked for twelve years in the banking industry, as Regional Vice President for Citicorp Securities, and later as Managing Director of Global Trading for Security Pacific National Bank in Los Angeles. He graduated from Emory University School of Law in 1993, where he was Associate Editor of the Emory Law Journal and published a law review article on securities fraud. Following law school, Chris clerked for the Honorable Jack T. Camp, United States District Judge, Northern District of Georgia. He later worked with the Atlanta office of Jones, Day, Reavis and Pogue where he practiced primarily in the areas of business law and litigation. In 1996 he formed Williamson & York, a business law firm, and later merged with the personal injury firm of Tillman & Associates to form Tillman & York. In 2008, Chris joined the law firm of George & Wallach where he practices workers' compensation and personal injury law and litigation. Although Chris now practices independently from the firm, he maintains an "Of Counsel" relationship.

Awards and Honors

attorneys.name: David Zagoria
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Atlanta, GA
attorneys.bio:
Attorney David Zagoria has been practicing law for 17 years, serving as an assistant district attorney in Fulton County and now as a partner in his current law practice. Originally experienced in criminal law, David now advocates for clients in a variety of personal injury cases. He also serves on the Membership Committee of the Georgia Trial Lawyers Association.

David's years of courtroom experience inform his approach to personal injury law. Every case he takes on is investigated as thoroughly as possible, to be prepared in the event it has to be argued before a jury. One example of this is a case for a client whose leg was seriously injured by a commercial vehicle. The insurance company's offer of settlement was too low, so David took the case to trial and won a significantly larger verdict for his client.

It is a good example of what he finds rewarding about personal injury law – helping people who have truly been injured due to no fault of their own. Explains David, ”I make sure they get the medical care they need and the compensation they deserve so they can move on with their lives.”

David's advice to his clients is, “See your doctor, let your injuries heal. I'll take care of the rest for you.”

A native to Atlanta, David spends his free time relaxing at the lake, golfing and following the Hawks.

attorneys.name: Shirley Zambrano
attorneys.practice_type: Immigration law Lawyers in Atlanta, GA
attorneys.bio:
Ms. Shirley Zambrano is the Managing Attorney at Zambrano Law, a firm nationally recognized for its fierce and compassionate advocacy on behalf of immigrants. Her practice is anchored in immigration law, where she represents individuals and families navigating some of the most complex legal challenges, including deportation defense, asylum, family-based petitions, waivers, and employment visas. She has successfully obtained visas and green cards for Grammy-nominated Latin music artists, managers, athletes, models, and other individuals with extraordinary ability.

Consistently named a Super Lawyers Rising Star in immigration law for five consecutive years, Ms. Zambrano is known for her sharp legal skills, relentless advocacy, and deep personal commitment to the immigrant community. As an immigrant from Ecuador, she brings a unique perspective to her work—combining legal excellence with lived experience.

Ms. Zambrano also represents immigrants who have suffered injuries in car accidents, helping them secure compensation and justice regardless of their immigration status. Her ability to navigate both immigration and personal injury law makes her an invaluable advocate for clients whose cases span across legal systems.

Her insights and leadership have earned her recognition from major media outlets such as Huffington Post, WSB-TV Atlanta, CBS46 Atlanta, Univision, and Telemundo. She is a frequent speaker at legal and immigration conferences across the country.

Ms. Zambrano is licensed to practice immigration law in all 50 states. She graduated magna cum laude from Florida Coastal School of Law, ranking in the top five percent of her class. During law school, she clerked for the U.S. District Court and U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Florida and interned at the U.S. Attorney’s Office for the Middle District of Florida, where she contributed to high-profile federal prosecutions.

attorneys.practice_type: Divorce/Family Law Lawyers in Duluth, GA
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Zdrilich is a native of Youngstown, Ohio. He co-founded his practice in 2007 and is committed to meeting the needs of families and persons seriously injured due to the negligence of others. He has successfully tried and mediated hundreds of cases, including divorce cases, child support and alimony modifications, contempt proceedings, personal injury cases on behalf of plaintiffs, and criminal defense matters. He has also handled several family law matters on appeal to the Georgia Supreme Court. He is admitted to practice in all Georgia Courts, as well as the U.S. District Courts for the Northern District of Georgia, the Middle District of Georgia, and the 11th Circuit Court of Appeals. He is ready to bring his energy and experience to bear in your case.

Mr. Zdrilich is active in the local bar, and has committed time and energy in serving the Gwinnett County Bar Association, both as its secretary, treasurer, and currently, vice president. He has published articles in the Gwinnett County Bar Association newsletter and judged Mock Trial Tournament. He has also served on the State Bar of Georgia's Local Bar Activities Committee, and is an active member of the Lawrenceville Kiwanis Club, the Lawyer's Club of Atlanta, and the Georgia Trial Lawyers Association.
